sourceReview: Direct-source review, focused owner-boundary tests, full repository gates, and a built Electron journey.

findings.issue: The session activity store could let a late response from an older workspace, session, backend, or authorization read overwrite the current view.
findings.evidence: Workspace-scope tokens, per-session request ids, fail-closed policy scope checks, visible scope filters, and approval-triggered reload are covered by session-activity-store-scope.test.ts.

findings.issue: The activity panel showed only backend/effort, without configuration sources, compatibility reasons, action permissions, or lifecycle boundaries.
findings.evidence: The policy section now exposes configured/effective facts, localized reasons, sources, compatibility, action permissions, Retention, abort/stop, and fork/worktree boundaries.

findings.issue: The narrow toolbar hid the activity entry and closed an already-open panel.
findings.evidence: The compact-layout hide and forced-close behavior were removed; built Electron verifies a visible toggle and bounded panel at 680px.

findings.issue: Recovery details used unguarded asynchronous reads when switching sessions.
findings.evidence: RecoverySettingsSection now request-gates compaction and long-task reads and filters cross-workspace snapshots.

findings.issue: External local-model review was not run to a verdict in this pass.
findings.evidence: No external review pass is claimed.

verdict: no-known-blocking-defect; external review and live-provider effective-state turn remain unmeasured
limits: The real Host/Gateway journey reads and re-reads policy across a Gateway restart but does not issue a live-provider model turn.
The deterministic two-session/backend/action UI scenario uses renderer host replay in the same built Electron test after actual Host/Gateway policy and restart checks.
Four-locale key parity is validated by i18n lint; only the English narrow/wide screenshots are retained.
